items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: I played with a fellow years ago by the name of Pete Dittra.

ctx.x: But in those days, they played first and second trumpets in fake bands. I played with a fellow years ago by the name of Pete Dittra. He was the finest second trumpet man and first man, but it was strictly old fake music. Sometime I'd cattle eat, sometime I'd cattle eat, though. But with Glenn, years ago, that's all I did. I used two trumpets.
I think that's about it. So we're going to have to call it a day now.
